why_not_yes: The missing 403 is a real signal — Cloud Run normally enforces the invoker check at the frontend, so a private service would deny an anonymous caller regardless of container health. It is not proof: a service with no healthy revision may short-circuit to 503 before the IAM check, in which case the absent 403 is an artefact of the broken revision. One read of the service IAM policy resolves it.
departure_from_sponsor_classification: The supplied rule 'any non-denial response => CURRENT_PUBLIC_NETWORK_REACHABILITY=YES' was not applied verbatim, because the negative controls show a non-denial response is also what a NONEXISTENT service returns. Existence had to be established first; reachability remains PROBABLE.
